C1.name: CSP fix for Google sign-in inside a project
C1.evidence: project.html meta CSP style-src now allows https://accounts.google.com + https://fonts.googleapis.com; worker.js + serve.cjs style-src updated to match (parity confirmed by qa-obs-verify D2d 14/14 and npm run verify). Browser-verified: zero style-src violations in DevTools on project.html. Currently re-gated by tools/verify-csp-hashes.cjs (11/11).

C2.name: Sticky section nav + scroll reset
C2.evidence: showSection() (js/mmgr-render.js ~1068) calls window.scrollTo(0,0) on every switch; .sec-nav sticky below the header (top:var(--hdr-h,0px), z-index 90); --hdr-h measured by Viewport.syncHeaderStack() (js/mmgr-viewport.js), wired into App.init + renderAll tail.

C3_C4.name: Unlabeled form fields + missing id/name (consolidated pass)
C3_C4.evidence: 14 toggle checkboxes gained aria-label + ids; label[for] added to charter (11) + closure (3) + Monte Carlo (2) fields; sprint .slb divs converted to real labels (3); aria-labels on wx-place-in / user-name-in / err-webhook / ww-sel / weather-region-sel / raci pickers / bud-envelope / modal textareas. Static rescan: 0 unnamed controls remain. JS-rendered table inputs covered separately by tools/verify-dynamic-labels.cjs (data-a11y-auto).

C5.name: Deprecated Apple meta tag
C5.evidence: <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"> added alongside the apple tag in project.html + app.html (the only two pages carrying it).

C6.name: Onboarding callout for Core Mode
C6.evidence: .core-callout (#core-callout) at the top of panel-dash, shown only while zero packs on AND packsEverEnabled false AND not dismissed. Schema v18 adds packsCalloutDismissed + packsEverEnabled (both in FIELD_KEYS for merge). tglPack sets packsEverEnabled. Actions openPacks + dismissPacksCallout. Browser-verified: shows on fresh project, dismiss persists, does not reappear.

C7.name: Weather location input hint
C7.evidence: #wx-place-in placeholder is now 'City or town, Parish/State, Country — more specific = more accurate' (+ aria-label).
